hypotheses.title: Variance Risk Premium Conditioned on Fundamental Cashflow Efficiency (option8 + model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Raw variance risk premium (historical vol minus implied vol) captures options underpricing but suffers in small-cap junk names. Conditioning on cross-sectional fundamental cashflow quality (cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative) isolates robust firms where volatility mispricing resolves safely, driving up Sharpe and Sub-universe consistency.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during prolonged market-wide volatility expansions where realized volatility exceeds implied volatility across all market tiers.

candidates.expression: vrp = historical_volatility_30 - implied_volatility_mean_30; quality = group_rank(cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative, industry); signal = group_zscore(vrp, industry) * quality; clipped = min(max(signal, -2.5), 2.5); pwr = signed_power(clipped, 2); group_neutralize(pwr, industry)

hypotheses.title: Options Volatility Term Structure Backwardation Reversion (option8 + model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The volatility term structure slopes upward in contango during calm periods (90-day IV > 30-day IV). When near-term panic strikes, 30-day IV spikes above 90-day IV into backwardation. Fading severe near-term backwardation on high cashflow quality companies captures the panic recovery premium.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms when inverted term structures correctly anticipate persistent corporate deterioration.

candidates.expression: term_spread = implied_volatility_mean_90 - implied_volatility_mean_30; quality = group_rank(cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative, industry); signal = group_zscore(term_spread, industry) * quality; clipped = min(max(signal, -2.5), 2.5); pwr = signed_power(clipped, 2); group_neutralize(pwr, industry)

hypotheses.title: Downside Put Skew Exhaustion Conditioned on Fundamental Quality (option8 + model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: When institutional and retail investors panic-hedge against downside crash risk, 30-day put implied volatility violently exceeds call implied volatility. Fading excessive downside skew on firms with superior operational cash generation exploits panic overshoot.
confounders: Severe overnight market-wide black swan events
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during systemic solvency shocks where elevated put demand precedes further collapse.

candidates.expression: skew = implied_volatility_put_30 - implied_volatility_call_30; quality = group_rank(cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative, industry); signal = -group_zscore(skew, industry) * quality; clipped = min(max(signal, -2.5), 2.5); pwr = signed_power(clipped, 2); group_neutralize(pwr, industry)
